value.rationale: Mean inactivity is a physical reliability descriptor emphasized by the original distribution paper and is a conditional expectation of nonnegative t−Y. The source formula predicts a negative value for all sufficiently small positive times, violating that fundamental interpretation, and reverses its leading t² coefficient. Correcting an analytically published distribution formula with such an impossible behavior has concrete mathematical and interpretational value; this is not a mere typographic notation variant.
residual_risks: Broader statistical model not audited; correction is only for one formula.

final_claim: For alpha>0,t>0, the inverted ZLindley CDF F(t)=(1+alpha/(2(1+alpha)t))exp(-alpha/t) has integral alpha Gamma(-1,alpha/t)+alpha E1(alpha/t)/(2(1+alpha)), with E1(z)=-Ei(-z); the published Eq(15) has the opposite Ei sign, making published mean inactivity asymptotic -t^2/alpha instead of true +t^2/alpha as t downarrow 0.
limitations: Only α>0 and t>0 with standard real Ei are asserted.
